The passmcp family

15 components, one version.

The family moves in lockstep: one version across every component, released together. Each status links to its release, or to the changelog that tracks what is not released yet.

The components of the passmcp family, what each is for, and its release status
ComponentPurposeStatus
passmcpThe engine, every check, and the three peer surfaces: CLI, TUI and the embedded local web UI.Released in 0.0.10
passmcp-reportingThe attestation predicate, its JSON Schema and the offline verifier, as a module with no dependencies; the report schema, the renderers and the rubric as data follow when a consumer needs them.Released in 0.0.10
passmcp-serverAn MCP server exposing passmcp's diagnostics as read-only tools, so an agent can evaluate a server, or check an attestation about one, from inside the editor.Released in 0.0.10
passmcp-actionThe GitHub Action wrapping the published image by digest, and a GitLab CI template.Released in 0.0.10
passmcp-graphA local graph of which agents use which MCP servers, which tools those servers expose and which identities reach them, built from passmcp's attestations, reports and MCP client configurations, queried offline and gated by policy in CI.Released in 0.0.10
passmcp-registryThe tooling for a signed public scorecard of the remote servers in the MCP Registry: each checked read-only and without credentials by a pinned passmcp release, every result an offline-verifiable attestation, and anything that would expose a vulnerability withheld for its owner first. No run has been published yet.Released in 0.0.10
passmcp-lspA language server over MCP artefacts — server.json, tool schemas, client configuration, passmcp policy and attestation files — with check-id hover from the guidance catalogue.Released in 0.0.10
passmcp-censusThe reliability census of the MCP Registry's remote servers: the methodology, the disclosure log and the command that reproduces the figures. No edition has been published yet.Released in 0.0.10
satellion.comThe public site at satellion.com, built with SSG against passmcp's latest release: the home page, the manual and a sample report passmcp generates.Released in 0.0.10
passmcp-sdk-goMCP client and server SDK for Go covering revisions 2025-06-18 through 2026-07-28 (stdio and Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, SEP-2164, SEP-2549, stateless server/discover, read-only defaults) and offline passmcp attestation verification.Released in 0.0.10
